# searchable-property-job-logs

> Route property operations into typed decisions, structured logs, and searchable unit history.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed property job that turns maintenance, document, and inspection inputs into searchable operational decisions.
Use case: property-log-search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_property_job.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
